title: Service Recovery, Welfare Renewal Manus Open Data Recovery and Launch Return Rewards
excerpt: AI Assistant Platform Manus announced today that the platform services have been fully restored and are running stably, and the data recovery feature is now off
content_html:
AI Assistant Platform Manus announced today that the platform services have been fully restored and are running stably, and the data recovery feature is now officially available. Users who have completed data backups can perform data recovery at any time without time restrictions. For accounts affected by the previous service issues, Manus will also provide a return reward.

According to the official introduction, due to an abnormal increase in traffic yesterday, some users were unable to complete the data recovery process immediately. The Manus team has increased the processing capacity and stability of the recovery system, and most users can now complete the data recovery as expected. The official stated that short delays may still occur during peak hours, and the platform will continue to monitor system performance and optimize the service experience.

For users who encounter problems during the recovery process, Manus recommends trying again later, referring to the official recovery guide, or contacting the 24/7 customer support team for assistance.

This service recovery means that Manus has completed the system adjustments following the previous abnormal traffic. As the AI agent platform gradually handles more user data and automated tasks, data security, stability, and disaster recovery capabilities have become key foundational abilities for the large-scale development of AI applications.
